summary: Computes the slip-velocity norm. Builds the displacement between a reference point (this+0x3B60/0x3B64/0x3B68) and the current position (this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC), rotates it into the local frame via the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x34B0..0x34D0, takes the Euclidean norm, adds the bias literal 3.2, and clamps to the minimum threshold this+0x3B6C. Invoked by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch (0x004EB430).

local_names.this: particle-effect/vehicle context holding position, rotation and a slip reference
local_names.v6: local-frame component from the rotation matrix row 0
local_names.v7: local-frame component from the rotation matrix row 1
local_names.v4: local-frame component from the rotation matrix row 2

operations.description: Compute the displacement components between the reference point (this+0x3B60/0x3B64/0x3B68) and the current position (this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC)
Rotate the displacement into the local frame by dotting it with the three rotation matrix rows at this+0x34B0..0x34D0, producing v6, v7 and v4
Compute the slip-velocity norm as sqrt(v4*v4 + v7*v7 + v6*v6) plus the bias literal 3.2
Clamp: if the threshold field this+0x3B6C is greater than the computed norm, return the threshold value instead
Return the computed slip-velocity norm; the function is invoked by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch (0x004EB430)
